description: Show an interactive live card for one market in the chat: live price, today's range (UTC), a mini order book with the biggest walls within 1 % of price, the nearest key levels above and below, and a button that opens the free live order book heatmap on swiftedge.uk. Use it when the user wants to see, watch or check a market; the user can switch between all fifteen markets in the card.

market.description: Market: btc, gold, eth, sol, xrp, us500, us100, silver, oil, eurusd, nvidia, google, apple, tesla, spacex

name: show_live_market
